_note: Prices are in dollars. The checkout reads prices from this file, so changing a price here changes what customers pay. Set available to false to hide an item.
_plan: plan = the column name in the operations sheet Plan tab. If that column's TOTAL is 0, the item shows as Not available this week. Items without plan (pita) are always available.
